body.text: {param:town} is to be {param:intent}. I am telling you because you will find out.
I am doing it because I must. The ground and the season and the men I have leave me one course, and I have taken it.
I do not ask your opinion of it. You are welcome to have one.

tone.text: As to your course, I am {choice}.

options.text: not much taken with your manner
